name: papercraft
title: Papercraft
summary: Layered paper collage: torn sheets with white cores and soft shadows, clean-cut shapes, flat colour and printed papers.

name: render-3d
title: 3D render
summary: Soft-lit raymarched 3D: smooth blended forms with soft shadows, ambient occlusion, rim light and glossy highlights.

name: cad
title: CAD drawing
summary: Line work in layer colours on a dark model-space ground: orthographic views, hatched sections and computed dimensions in a stroke font.

name: pixel-art
title: Pixel art
summary: 2D pixel art on a coarse grid: a small palette, Bayer dithering, one-pixel outlines and stepped shading.

name: embroidery
title: Embroidery
summary: Bright satin-stitch fills and couched strands, each with a dark edge and a sheen, on dark woven cloth.

name: sticker
title: Sticker
summary: Flat, bold-outlined vinyl art die-cut with a white border, one soft shadow and a gloss streak, sometimes peeling.

name: voxel
title: Voxel
summary: Isometric voxel blocks as in Minecraft: 16 x 16 texel faces lit only by orientation, culled and drawn back to front.

name: doodle
title: Doodle
summary: Ballpoint lines gone over twice, hatching instead of fills, bubble letters and a highlighter swipe, on notebook paper.

name: kandinsky
title: Kandinsky
summary: Haloed circles, rings, triangles, arcs, bars and crossing lines in glazed primaries on warm paper, after Kandinsky's Bauhaus work.

name: impasto
title: Impasto
summary: Thick oil dabs with lit and shadowed ridges, laid along a swirling flow and wrapping each form under one light.

name: circuit-board
title: Circuit board
summary: Copper in 45-degree runs under green solder mask, gold where the mask opens, white silkscreen and soldered parts, seen from above.

name: watercolour
title: Watercolour
summary: Transparent washes glazed in faint layers on cold-press paper, with soft and dried edges, pooled pigment, granulation and lifted lights.

name: sumi-e
title: Sumi-e
summary: Ink brush strokes pressed and lifted, running dry into streaks, in tones of one black on rice paper with much empty space.

name: star-atlas
title: Star atlas
summary: Stars as discs sized by magnitude on deep blue, a projected grid, and thin constellation lines over faint engraved figures.

name: light-painting
title: Light painting
summary: Long-exposure trails of hand-held light that only add, each a soft glow round a white-hot core, over a near-black night.

name: pen-and-pencil
title: Pen and pencil
summary: A sepia ballpoint line that swells, skips and pools, over coloured-pencil hatching or a loose scribble fill, broken by the tooth of creased cream paper.

name: manga
title: Manga
summary: Black ink on white: pressure pen lines, screentone dots, hatching, speed and focus lines, and drawings held on twos.

name: gouache
title: Mid-century gouache
summary: Opaque matte flats in a few colours per scene, crisp edges that break into dry-brush streaks, simple sky gradients, and dark front planes round a lit opening.

name: flat-cartoon
title: Flat cartoon
summary: Flat fills inside a closed ink line that swells, tapers and weighs on the shadow side, one hard cel shade per part, blush and white shines, and outlined sound-effect lettering.

name: print-plate
title: Print plates
summary: A print in separations: a plate per ink multiplied over paper, colours as overprints, whites as knockouts, dot screens at each ink's angle and a register offset per ink.

name: backlit-silhouette
title: Backlit silhouettes
summary: Flat sheets in front of a lit screen: translucent gels that tint the light and darken where they overlap, opaque cards that read as black with openings cut through, no shadows and no edges.
